method: fetch_reviews.py search and reviews (Apple public search and customer review RSS), reviews rated 3 stars or under, 3 pages per app. Raw files in state/scout/reviews/<app id>.json. No WebFetch, no Reddit, no logins.

candidates.trend_signals: Month-lock complaints from EveryDollar all fall between 2026-11-04 and 2026-11-10 (a burst after one release); the source does not say whether the feature will change. Not a long-run trend.
candidates.not_found: Evidence is thin on breadth: the lock-out complaints concern one app and one release; the schedule complaints are 2 on EveryDollar and 2 on Bills Manager (one from 2025). Other zero-based apps (Goodbudget, YNAB) were not searched.

candidates.not_found: These are reviewer claims about data practices. The scout did not read either privacy policy and does not verify them. Without bank linking the job would rely on manual entry or statement import; no review asks for that in those words, though one Spendee review (2026-05-29) says the user needs it to track spending from bank info directly, which points the other way. Evidence of demand for a private tracker versus the convenience of linking is mixed.

candidates.not_found: Reading of effort: reviews do not say whether the fault is the aggregator or the app, so it is unknown whether a new small app could do better. The job likely needs a bank-data aggregator contract, which this scout did not check; it may not suit one small app. A user network or licensed content is not required.

excluded_note: No candidate or app fell on data/excluded_categories.yaml. state/scout/rejected.jsonl has no Finance entries. Candidates avoid the Productivity, Business, Education and Health items listed there.
price_only_not_candidates: Complaints that were only about price, free-tier limits (for example 5 bills free), trial billing or refunds were seen in large numbers at Rocket Money, Bills Organizer, Bobby, Spendee, Subpilot, MonoBoost, Bill Tracker Pro and Monarch. They were not made into candidates.
other_themes_seen_not_candidates: Portfolio and brokerage tracking accuracy (Empower and Copilot, about 4 complaints, 2 apps, not read further); iPhone Duo layout support (Monarch, Copilot, many 2026-10 and 2026-11 reviews, a platform support issue, not a job); Spendee 6 redesign lag (Aug to Sep 2026, one app).
could_not_find_or_open: No keyword volume or difficulty source was used (none given and no public one tried).
No trend data source was used beyond review dates.

Apps with fewer than about 100 ratings, and the small apps returned by searches (Fleur, Spending Tracker, Buddy, WorthTracker, NerdWallet), were not read; Fleur and Spending Tracker returned only 10 low-rated reviews each and were saved but not analysed.
Review feeds return only the most recent pages; the Bobby and Bills Manager reviews reach back to 2022 to 2025, so older items in those apps are marked by date.
